title: CapabilitiesRegistry
description: Schema for config/capabilities.registry.json — which capability servers exist, how to reach them, and what secrets they need. Renamed from v1.0's mcp.servers.json.

breaking_changes: 1.1.0 — requires_network, offline_allowed, owner, phase and trust_level became REQUIRED on every capability. MAJOR for producers (an existing registry without them now fails validation), which is the intent: L0-NETDEP-004 proved that an optional network declaration is unenforceable, because absence is not a declaration of false.
compatibility.notes: THIS IS A CONFIG SCHEMA, so additionalProperties is FALSE at every level — per ADR-0015 an unknown key is an error, not a silent ignore. A typo'd key that is quietly dropped leaves the system running on a default the operator believes they overrode. Wire-payload schemas in this contract set take the opposite stance deliberately; see contracts/README.md. AS OF 1.1.0 the five governance fields are mandatory. ADR-0007's L0 exclusion was previously expressed only in prose; these fields make it machine-checkable.

command.description: stdio only. NOT A SHELL STRING — argv[0]. Arguments go in `args`, never interpolated into a command line. ADR-0011 forbids any path from free text to an interpreter.

module.description: inproc only. Import path of the service entrypoint.

secrets.description: Environment name -> secret:// URI. ADR-0015: URIs ONLY. The ${GITHUB_PAT} interpolation in v1.0 was broken (JSON does not expand variables) and the natural fix — interpolating in the loader — produces plain strings that leak into logs.

scope.description: Capability-specific constraint, e.g. project_root_only for the filesystem server.

side_effect_default.description: Floor for tools this server exposes. An individual ToolSpec may declare HIGHER, never lower.

requires_network.description: REQUIRED. ADR-0007: true excludes this capability at tier L0. Declared explicitly on every entry — absence is not a declaration of false, and L0-NETDEP-004 rejects an undeclared field. Must be the logical inverse of `offline_allowed`.

supervised.description: ADR-0014. stdio servers MUST be supervised — Windows has no process groups and an unsupervised child orphans grandchildren that hold ports.

offline_allowed.description: REQUIRED. Whether the L0 host may load this capability. ADR-0007 makes this the inverse of `requires_network`; both are stated so the intent is explicit and the gate can cross-check them rather than infer one from the other. A contradiction between the two is a violation, not a preference.

owner.description: REQUIRED. Module accountable for this capability, drawn from the same vocabulary as contract ownership. Ownership decides who must be consulted, not who is to blame.

phase.description: REQUIRED. The gate at which this capability is first built. Makes the registry readable as a delivery plan and lets a gate check that nothing is registered before the phase that introduces it.

trust_level.description: REQUIRED. Trust level this capability's OUTPUT carries into a turn — distinct from `trust_required`, which is the minimum caller trust needed to INVOKE it. A capability that returns file contents or remote data must declare `external_content`: ADR-0012 treats such output as hostile, and this field is what makes ToolResult.trust_of_output correct by construction rather than by convention.

governance_note.description: Why this entry's governance fields hold the values they do. Distinct from `note`, which describes the capability. Recorded because `requires_network: false` is a claim about the world that someone should be able to check without re-deriving it.

allOf.$comment: ADR-0007 consistency: requires_network and offline_allowed are logical inverses. Stated separately so a mismatch is detectable; a capability cannot claim to need the network and also be loadable offline.

github.note: Digest is all-zero HERE ONLY because this is a schema example illustrating shape — it is not a lockfile entry and must never be copied into one. The real digest lives in artifacts.lock.yaml, currently UNRESOLVED. requires_network true excludes this capability at tier L0.
